comment: The beat and cycle counts are module state rather than parameters (Picus.cpp:88), so Rack's own reset and randomize are handled by the module: a reset sets every count to one, and a randomize draws a beat count of 0 to 12 and a cycle count of 1 to 9 (Picus.cpp:264). The first stage's cycle count is clamped to at least one so that stage can never be skipped (Picus.cpp:384). The last sub-beat of each stage is left out because the stage advance fires its own trigger in that slot (Picus.cpp:455).
